variants.prompt: In a candlelit chamber, the enigmatic beauty sits cross-legged on a plush ottoman, her captivating emerald gaze fixed intently on the viewer. A soft, rosy glow illuminates her porcelain skin, highlighting the delicate lace trim of her high-necked corset and the subtle rosy hue that warms her cheeks. Her long, rich chestnut waves fall around her like a velvet curtain, framing the vulnerable, soft expression on her face.
